[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Music Major in Music Composition","groupId":"c097ab64-3816-4d0f-9374-019568266f57","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Music degree with a major in music composition.

","groupId":"b1a51d0f-f115-4849-b041-019568266f57","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"5c389869-7913-45f2-a126-019568270297","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"1d40047a-6874-4a4b-8b04-019568270297","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Requirements","groupId":"3249fabb-acc3-4f3b-bfb2-01956827a510","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.  

","groupId":"eafd1116-f3d3-415a-a5e1-01956827a510","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"1d3037fc-7370-4696-86f9-019568280792","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Note: No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

","groupId":"81770084-8a13-4c7f-a50c-019568280792","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"0321f3ac-5e8a-45c1-95b2-019568288eb5","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"a77375d5-b1e4-462f-9196-019568288eb5","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"f95d9850-93ce-486d-a985-019568290768","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"5e76d84c-828f-4321-a0fe-019568290768","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"9406b573-8134-4016-8d11-0195682c34a6","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) An end-of-the-year advisory portfolio review is required of all composition majors. Admission to the upper division is based on a review of the student’s work at the end of the second year.

2) A senior composition project is required in the senior year.

3) Up to 11 elective courses are required.

4) Eight units and eight semesters of MPER are required.
